title: List the names of players who have the highest potential score among those
question: List the names of players who have the highest potential score among those with a balance score above the average balance of all players in 2014 and whose preferred foot is 'right'.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.XCL_123
FROM Player p
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
WHERE pa.XCL_134 = 'right'
  AND pa.XCL_155 > (
    SELECT AVG(pa2.XCL_155)
    FROM Player_Attributes pa2
    WHERE SUBSTRING(pa2.XCL_131, 1, 4) = '2014'
  )
  AND pa.XCL_133 = (
    SELECT MAX(pa3.XCL_133)
    FROM Player_Attributes pa3
    WHERE pa3.XCL_134 = 'right'
      AND pa3.XCL_155 > (
        SELECT AVG(pa4.XCL_155)
        FROM Player_Attributes pa4
        WHERE SUBSTRING(pa4.XCL_131, 1, 4) = '2014'
      )
  )

      AND pa3.XCL_155 > (

        WHERE SUBSTRING(pa4.XCL_131, 1, 4) = '2014'
